verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an AI video generator, so a cheap draft mode with later upscaling is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no draft or preview render tier and no way to upscale a chosen take to final quality. It covers only finished-video generation, MP4 download, webhooks and editing collaboration, none of which is a draft-then-upscale workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality
